title: SMD / PCB Contract Manufacturing
description: Reusable vertical structure for contract PCB assembly and related electronics manufacturing services.

pages.purpose: Present PCB assembly and related production services.
Present equipment when it materially supports capability evidence.
Explain quality control methods and the evidence available to support them.

conditional_rules.if: The business accepts project or production files online.
conditional_rules.then: Include the file-upload pattern in the conversion flow.

conditional_rules.if: Verified production cases are available and can be disclosed.
Equipment materially supports the explanation of production capabilities.
conditional_rules.then: Include an equipment page or equipment evidence block.

conditional_rules.if: Certifications or applicable production standards can be disclosed.
conditional_rules.then: Present them as verified quality evidence without implying unsupported certification.

constraints: Do not infer component packages, tolerances, batch sizes, standards or equipment from industry norms.
All technical capabilities, supported technologies and project input requirements must be verified for the specific manufacturer.
Distinguish currently supported capabilities from planned, target or partner-delivered capabilities.
Production cases and technical evidence must use real, disclosable project information.
